problem.text: Requests are frequently routed to the wrong department, causing delays and manual rerouting by reviewers. There is no measurement of how often this occurs, and the process is inefficient.

goals.text: Reduce the time requests sit before reaching the correct team.
Provide reviewers with advisory triage recommendations that cite the relevant routing policies.
Ensure all recommendations and assistant tool usage are auditable.
Support both English and French for Montréal office users.

requirements.text: The assistant must provide advisory routing and priority suggestions for each new request, citing the relevant policy IDs and versions.
Reviewers must confirm or reroute the assistant's suggestion; no automatic routing or approval is allowed.
Every recommendation and lookup by the assistant must be auditable, including who asked, when, and what was returned.
The system should support both English and French interfaces.
If a request is rerouted after a suggestion, the UI must indicate that the suggestion is stale.

outOfScope.text: Automatic approval or routing of requests without reviewer confirmation.

successMeasures.text: The share of requests rerouted after triage, measured for two weeks before and after the assistant is enabled.

epic.title: Assisted Request Triage
epic.summary: Deliver an advisory assistant that recommends routing and priority for incoming requests, citing policies, supporting audit, and enabling reviewer confirmation in English and French.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new request, When the assistant generates a recommendation, Then the reviewer sees the suggested department, priority, rationale, and cited policy IDs and versions.
Given a reviewer confirms or reroutes a suggestion, When the action is taken, Then the system records an audit entry with who acted, when, and what was returned.
Given a request is rerouted after a suggestion, When the reviewer views the request, Then the UI indicates the suggestion is stale.
Given the assistant is unavailable, When a reviewer opens a request, Then the panel shows an unavailable message and manual routing stays enabled.

tasks.title: Implement Policy-Based Triage Recommendation Engine
tasks.description: Develop the backend service to generate advisory routing and priority suggestions for new requests, citing relevant policy IDs and versions.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new request, When the engine processes it, Then it returns a suggested department, priority, rationale, and policy citations.
Given a request with missing information, When the engine cannot determine a department, Then it marks the request for human review and asks a clarifying question.
Given a request matches multiple policies, When a conflict exists, Then the engine returns all relevant policy citations in the rationale.

tasks.title: Reviewer Confirmation and Manual Rerouting UI
tasks.description: Build the frontend interface for reviewers to confirm or reroute suggestions, display rationales, and indicate when a suggestion is stale.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reviewer opens a request, When a suggestion is available, Then the UI displays the suggested department, priority, rationale, and policy citations.
Given a reviewer reroutes a request after a suggestion, When the request is viewed again, Then the UI marks the suggestion as stale.
Given a reviewer double-clicks to confirm a suggestion, When the action is processed, Then only one audit entry and one notification are created.
Given the assistant is unavailable, When a reviewer opens a request, Then the UI shows an unavailable message and enables manual routing.

tasks.title: Audit Logging for Recommendations and Actions
tasks.description: Ensure all recommendations, lookups, and reviewer actions are logged with user, timestamp, and returned data for audit purposes.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reviewer requests a recommendation, When the assistant responds, Then an audit entry is created with the user, time, and result.
Given a reviewer confirms or reroutes a suggestion, When the action is taken, Then an audit entry is created for the action.
Given a tool is used by the assistant to look up information, When the lookup occurs, Then the audit log records who, when, and what was returned.

tasks.title: Localization for English and French
tasks.description: Add support for English and French in the triage assistant UI and recommendation outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reviewer in the Montréal office, When the UI is loaded, Then all triage assistant features are available in French.
Given a reviewer in another office, When the UI is loaded, Then all triage assistant features are available in English.
Given a reviewer switches language preference, When the UI reloads, Then all assistant outputs and labels appear in the selected language.

openQuestions.question: Who is allowed to override a suggestion: only reviewers, or approvers as well?
How long should recommendations be retained in the audit log?
What is the baseline for request rerouting before the assistant is enabled?
What is the agreed definition of 'fast' for assistant response time?

conflicts.summary: Ava wants automatic routing when the assistant is confident, but Priya and policy POL-GOV-001 require reviewer confirmation for all recommendations.
conflicts.resolution: The first release delivers recommendations plus reviewer confirmation; no automatic routing without a person confirming.

conflicts.summary: POL-ROUTE-004 requires expensive requests to go to Finance, but Ben and POL-ROUTE-001 claim IT owns all computing equipment regardless of cost.

decisions.decision: The first release delivers recommendations plus reviewer confirmation; no automatic routing without a person confirming.
